title: Finite correlated equilibria and regret certificates
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: For finite games with player-specific action types, a valid independent product distribution is a correlated equilibrium exactly when its mixed profile is Nash. The correlated-equilibrium set is nonempty, compact, and convex when every player's action type is nonempty. For every positive finite horizon, cumulative external-regret and swap-regret bounds give corresponding approximate coarse-correlated and correlated equilibria of the empirical distribution.
